title: Algerian Clotted Cream Crumble
description: A classic Algerian dessert with a twist, featuring a crumbly crust and a creamy topping.
instructions: Roll out the Algerian pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch round baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the clotted cream and granulated sugar until well combined.
Pour the clotted cream mixture over the pastry dough.
In another bowl, mix the melted butter and flour until a crumbly mixture forms.
Add the confectioners sugar and crumble topping to the butter mixture and mix until well combined.
Spread the crumble topping evenly over the clotted cream mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Dust with confectioners sugar and serve warm.
